changes: SPSC completion wait now checks and waits on the same observed value, then acquire-loads after waking. Both local peers check the expected payload sum.
All five MPMC source arms accumulate thread-local count/sum/xor, publish each result once, and verify dense ids1..N after join; no hot shared counter added.

Consumers enter a local draining phase only after acquiring all producer completion publications, then make a fresh pop before deciding empty. Moody enqueue failure is fatal rather than silently losing messages.
Historical ranking/theorem claims removed; sharded total capacity and growable peer distinctions stated. mpmc filter and fixed-one-epoch smoke mode added.

contracts.bounded_mpmc: Hyle/rigtorp each1024 usable global ring slots, try full/empty + same external yield. Constructor allocates/initializes; no per-op allocation, pop recycles/destroys; destructor only after all workers join. rigtorp allocates an additional padding slot. Current journey includes allocation and P+C fresh thread creation/join.
contracts.spsc: Hyle and current hand-written Folly-shaped peer both1024 usable/1025 physical slots, one producer/one consumer, acquire/release sentinel protocol, construction-only allocation and slot destruction on pop. One persistent worker pair at a time; allocation/worker creation outside timed runner. Current peer is not compiled Folly. Real local Folly constructor needs1025 to offer1024 usable.
contracts.sharded: Current P shards each1024 =>2048/4096 total in2P/4P rows, producer chooses stable shard, full means that shard full even if others have room. Pop round-robin scans at mostP shards, success moves past selected shard. Per-shard FIFO, no global FIFO.
contracts.moodycamel: 1024 is initial block storage, not a hard queue capacity nor a guarantee against later allocations. Current enqueue may grow and uses implicit producer registration; no producer/consumer token. Ordering per producer, consumer traversal heuristic differs; retired blocks/producer metadata retained/recycled until proper teardown. Cannot call this the same fixed-capacity full/backpressure contract as either bounded Hyle row.
contracts.empty_scans: Different search algorithms are potential real costs once the application trace/capacity/identity contract is aligned; they are not a reason to dismiss a fair loss by themselves.
contracts.unbounded: Hyle UnboundedQueue is absent from this benchmark; its independent producer/consumer locks, global FIFO and block allocation/reclamation are not represented by the moodycamel row.
